name: 3-(2-(2-methoxybenzylamino)ethyl)-1H-quinazoline-2,4-dione
summary: RH-34 is a compound which acts as a potent and selective partial agonist for the 5-HT2A serotonin receptor subtype. It was derived by structural modification of the selective 5-HT2A antagonist ketanserin, with the 4-(p-fluorobenzoyl)piperidine moiety replaced by the N-(2-methoxybenzyl) pharmacophore found in such potent 5-HT2A agonists as NBOMe-2C-B and NBOMe-2C-I.

pharmacology.text: RH-34 is a compound which acts as a potent and selective partial agonist for the 5-HT2A serotonin receptor subtype.
